title: Discovering the Ancient Romans
description: Foundational approach to the civilization of Rome through the evidence of literature, history and archaeology. Focus on shaping a cultural narrative of the Republic, Principate and Imperial eras through the integration of primary sources and other subjects. A basic timeline of principal eras and events, and general aspects of material culture from the foundation to the fall of Rome.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of GRS 102, GRS 100.
Equivalent of the second term of GRS 100.
